lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of approximately 6-7 vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the branchial region. These spots are arranged in a semi-regular 2D grid, with individual spots functioning as local maxima within vertical stripes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of higher pixel intensity run perpendicular to the body axis, with the high-luminance blobs situated at the intersections of these bands and faint horizontal lines, forming a structured grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary lateral ridge extends horizontally along the upper third of the flank, beginning posterior to the head and running towards the tail, characterized by a sharp light-to-shadow gradient.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 10-12 small, high-luminance spots is visible on the surface of the first dorsal fin, primarily located along the lower half and leading edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are attached to the ventral flank and trailing near the pectoral fin area.
